$comment: Dependency advisories we have SEEN and DECIDED about. Not a mute button.
scripts/audit-check.mjs fails the build on any high or critical advisory
that is not listed here, on any entry listed here that no longer appears
(so the file cannot rot), and on any entry past its reviewBy date (so an
accepted risk cannot quietly become permanent).
Adding an entry is a decision with a name and a date on it, the same rule
the breaker reset follows. If you cannot write an honest reason, the answer
is to fix the dependency, not to add the entry.
acceptedBy null means PROPOSED, not decided. The check prints such entries
as UNCONFIRMED on every run rather than passing them off as settled. Set
acceptedBy when the call is actually made.
EMPTY SINCE 2026-08-21, and that is the goal state. The three entries that
lived here — next, postcss and sharp, all high, all reached through next's
bundled copies — were accepted on 2026-08-12 pending the next 15 to 16
major. That upgrade landed on 2026-08-21 and npm audit reports 0. The check
fails on a stale entry, which is what made this file empty rather than
leaving three sentences here that had stopped being true.
One rule outlived its entry. The sharp acceptance rested on uploaded images
never reaching next/image, and deleting the entry would have left that
standing on a source comment alone. It is now test/reportPage.test.mjs R8,
which scans the trees where customer uploads render. If an entry you remove
carries a claim like that, move the claim before you delete the sentence.
